notes: BUU v3.0.2 - run-blocking fixes. Header whitespace: a sheet header with a trailing space became a row key with the space, so the token you would type resolved to blank (silently writing wrong data) and the column checker said 'missing' no matter what you typed. Headers are now trimmed at every read site and at token resolution - both sides, so your existing flows keep working - with a warning if trimming collapses two headers onto one key. Crash on close ('Object has been destroyed'): every send to the UI used a guard that could never fail, so closing BUU while workers were exiting crashed the main process. Schedules page was blank. Load flow demanded to save a flow that did not exist. Right-click Cut/Copy/Paste/Select-all now works - it was never implemented in any version.
